description: Baselines (SPEC section 7): accepted violations, keys without line numbers, and stale entries.

cases.name: without a baseline the violations are reported
a baseline that accepts all violations leaves none
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: comments and empty lines are ignored
cases.baseline:
# a comment

no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2

# another
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: a file without a line break at the end, and with Windows line breaks
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: more violations than the count: all with that key remain
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	1
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: a key that is not in the baseline remains
cases.baseline: no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2

cases.name: fewer violations than the count: the entry is stale
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	3
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: an entry for a violation that is gone is stale
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::gone	1
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: entries of other rules do not count and are not stale
cases.baseline:
another rule	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2
another rule	crate::a	uses use crate::gone	1

cases.name: entries of other units do not count
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::c	uses use crate::b::X	2
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: entries with the same key are added
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	1
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	1
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1

cases.name: a marker has the key `contains`
cases.baseline: no unsafe	crate::a	contains unsafe-block	1

cases.name: an allow-list violation has the key `uses`
cases.baseline: only std	crate::b	uses use crate::a::Y	1

cases.name: a cycle has its nodes as key, from the smallest
cases.baseline: no cycles	crate::a	cycle crate::a > crate::c	2

cases.name: a cycle counts for the nodes of its tangle, so a tangle that grows is not accepted

violations.note: the baseline accepts a tangle of 2

cases.baseline: no cycles	crate::a	cycle crate::a > crate::c	2

cases.name: a cycle entry with a count of 1 is from before the count was the size of the tangle, and the note says so

violations.note: the baseline accepts a tangle of 1: a baseline of a version before 0.2.0 has the number of cycles there, write it again

cases.baseline: no cycles	crate::a	cycle crate::a > crate::c	1

cases.name: a tangle that loses a node makes its entry stale
cases.baseline: no cycles	crate::a	cycle crate::a > crate::c	3

cases.name: a cycle that is written from another node is another key
cases.baseline: no cycles	crate::c	cycle crate::c > crate::a	1

cases.name: a rule with errors gives the same errors with a baseline
cases.baseline: no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2

cases.name: a line with three values is invalid
cases.baseline:
no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2
no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X

cases.name: a line with five values is invalid
cases.baseline: no b	crate::a	uses expr crate::b::X	1	1

cases.name: a count of zero is invalid
cases.baseline: no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	0

cases.name: a count that is not in digits is invalid
cases.baseline:
# header

no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	+2

cases.name: an empty value is invalid
cases.baseline: no b		uses use crate::b::X	1

cases.name: a line of spaces is invalid
cases.baseline: no b	crate::a	uses use crate::b::X	2
